The G-Shock GA-110AC-4AJF Men's Red Watch by Casio is designed to combine rugged durability with a striking, sporty style. This watch is perfect for those who lead an active lifestyle and need a timepiece that can keep up with their adventures. Its bold red color adds a dynamic touch, making it not just functional but also a statement accessory.

Built to withstand shocks and water exposure, this watch offers reliable performance in various environments. The genuine domestic Casio product ensures quality craftsmanship and lasting durability, making it a trustworthy companion for everyday wear and outdoor activities.

Details

  • Product Material: Resin and Mineral Glass
  • Manufacturer: Casio

Features

  • Shock resistant construction protects against impact and vibration
  • Water resistant up to 200 meters, suitable for swimming and snorkeling
  • Bold red design for a sporty and fashionable look
  • Digital and analog display for easy time reading
  • Durable resin band provides comfortable all-day wear

How to use

Set the time by pulling out the crown and rotating it to adjust the hands. Use the buttons to access additional features such as stopwatch, alarm, and world time. Wear the watch securely on your wrist for accurate timekeeping and comfort. Avoid exposing the watch to strong magnetic fields to maintain accuracy.

Care instructions

Clean the watch with a soft, damp cloth to remove dirt and sweat. Avoid using harsh chemicals or solvents that could damage the resin band or mineral glass. Keep the watch away from extreme temperatures and prolonged exposure to direct sunlight. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to maintain its condition.
